meta.units: mm, plan coordinates (same as floor_plan.json: +x right, +y down the page)
meta.source: Owner's sketches IMG_1367 (plan) + C1 elevation; glass partition per the BANGYUAN slim-frame reference (2026-10-26).
meta.orientation: Kitchen interior x 4300-8455 (west wall face to yard wall face), y 6000 (open edge to dining) - 8775 (south external wall face). Dining hall is north of y 6000.
meta.note: Work flow (2026-11-01): fridge (SW corner) -> landing -> sink -> main prep -> hob -> landing, along the south run, per common NKBA-style guidelines. Appliance sizes are typical catalogue sizes; confirm against the chosen models.

runs.name: South run
runs.note: From the fridge east: 300 fridge landing (drawers) | 800 sink | 600 dishwasher + 250 drawers (850 main prep between sink and hob) | 800 hob cabinet (pot drawers, no oven) | 345 landing past the hob. Ends 60 mm short of the yard wall so the yard door's south leaf can slide past.

base_cabinets.note: Bottom cabinets 900 mm high (incl. 30 mm worktop) - usable counter top for placing items.

runs.name: South
runs.note: Starts at the fridge's east side - nothing above the fridge.

top_cabinets.note: Up to the ceiling (2600). 650 mm clear above the counter; LED strip under.

hob.note: 780 mm hob at the east end, near the yard: short hood duct out through the yard wall.

hood.note: Slim pull-out hood under the top cabinet, ducted out via the yard (~0.5 m run).

sink.note: Undermount single bowl, west of the prep area. Water + waste re-routed from the yard end along the south wall under the cabinets (~1.5 m, keep the fall).

dishwasher.note: 600 built-in, next to the sink, under the main prep counter.

fridge.model: Hitachi R-GWC670TS (XM, Mirror Mauve Gray): 880 W x 654 D (650 without the drawer switch) x 1843 H, French doors + 2 small drawers + 2 large drawers
fridge.note: SW corner of the kitchen, facing north. 100 from the west wall so the hinge-side door can open past 90 (to pull out the shelves / crisper), ~50 from the back wall for ventilation, 20 to the counter. Nothing above it. Doors move on scene['door_fridge'] (0 closed - 1 open, 100 deg).

partition.note: Full-height slim black-frame glass sliding panels, top-hung, 6 panels on 6 tracks (telescopic). Opened, ALL panels slide east and stack flush against the side of the yard-wall cupboard (where the fridge was) in the slot between it and C1, leaving the full width open. Tracks span y ~5862-6055 (cupboard side at 6065, C1 ends at 5850). `open` (0-1) is the starting position after a rebuild; in Blender, move it with the HDB Reno tab (slider / Open / Close) or scene['door_kitchen_partition'].

c1.note: Runs the full east wall of the dining hall, from the glass partition to just before the corridor (RC wall ends at y 4450): 1400 W x 600 D (stops at y 5850 to leave the 6-track slot for the glass panels). Coffee / tea / matcha station on the dining side of the glass. Per the owner's elevation sketch: wine cellar at the bottom, drawer above it, coffee machine on the counter; top cabinet = whisky (bottom row), doors (middle), wine glasses (top), 3 columns. Wine cellar (600 W) at the corridor end, cabinet doors under the coffee / tea end. Under-counter wine cooler must be a low (~700 H) model, or drop the counter / drawer.

island.note: Movable island on lockable castors: 2000 x 700, 900 high (level with the counters). Pushed up to the glass partition; 1365 mm aisle to the south counter (~1260 to the fridge front, enough for the French doors), 855 to the yard-wall cupboard.

dining.note: 6-seater: 1800 x 800 (600 per person, 3 a side). Narrowed from 900 to free ~50 mm more chair space per side (925 each side in the 2650 mm deep hall); moved west to line up with the island, leaving ~955 mm between the table end and C1 for the walk to the corridor. Shifted 175 mm towards the glass (like the HDB brochure): 700 mm table edge -> glass for the south chairs, 1025 mm table edge -> bedroom 3 wall so people can walk behind the north chairs to the corridor.

kit_inside.note: L-cabinets + island from the yard door

kit_fridge.note: fridge with the French doors open, SW corner

kit_flow.note: fridge -> sink -> prep -> hob along the south run

kit_oven.note: full-height appliance tower, trays pulled out

appliance_tower.note: Full-height appliance tower on the yard wall (where the fridge was), 830 W x 600 D x 2600 H, like the owner's reference (The Interior Lab, Waterway Terraces II): 2 deep drawers at the bottom, an open niche at 720-1260 with a pull-out tray for the countertop oven + air fryer, a niche at 1290-1760 with a pull-out tray for the microwave, cabinet doors above to the ceiling. Trays slide out 380 on scene['door_kitchen_tray_1/2']. Appliances stay removable (plugged into sockets inside each niche). Covers the yard-wall window for now (owner: ignore the window).
